Above it a block gains damage (load - strength) / strength: below 1 closed and damaged (a reattempt is new work), at 1 fractured open. Separation takes an opened block apart into 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments (a unit of each is that part of one whole unit) with the source origin, age and decay; the kernel carries all food value and toxicity, whatever they are. Opened blocks not separated stay cracked unseparated material. Wear: a striker no harder than what it strikes, or a support softer by 0.5 than what presses on it, loses 0.0001 kg per contact. Cancel returns reserved material as it now is; death leaves it at the worksite. Nothing is refunded, made safe or eaten; edibility, nutrition and toxins stay unknown; no reward.
